definitions.explanation: stakeholder; a person or group with an interest or concern in a business, project, or organization

notes:
ステークホルダー is a business term from English "stakeholder," referring to anyone with an interest in a company or project.

TYPES OF STAKEHOLDERS:
- ⟦{株主|かぶぬし}→株主：15274_kabunushi⟧ (shareholders)
- ⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧ (employees)
- ⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧ (customers)
- ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧ (business partners)
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧ (local community)
- ⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}→行政：14122_gyousei⟧ (government)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ステークホルダー⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧ (stakeholder analysis)
- ステークホルダー⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (stakeholder management)
- ステークホルダー⟦エンゲージメント→エンゲージメント：08865_engeejimento⟧ (stakeholder engagement)
